aboutHeading: Over a Decade in Mill Park
aboutText: Millpark Building Inspections has been serving Mill Park and northern Melbourne's property community for over a decade. Our certified building and pest inspectors deliver clear, detailed reports that help buyers, sellers, and investors make confident decisions. We specialise in pre-purchase inspections, vendor reports, and defect assessments across Mill Park, South Morang, Doreen, and surrounding suburbs. With same-day report delivery and honest, straightforward communication, we take the stress out of understanding your property's true condition.
servicesText: Our building and pest inspection services cover Mill Park, South Morang, Doreen, and surrounding northern Melbourne suburbs. From pre-purchase assessments to vendor reports and new house inspections, we deliver thorough, professional reports backed by over a decade of local experience. Every inspection is performed by certified inspectors using current technology.
